{{Top|leg}}
'''The Shells''' was the name given to the series of roughly 200 concentric spherical shells located in the central sphere of [[Centerpoint Station]], surrounding [[Hollowtown]] at its center. [[Shell One]] was the innermost shell, and the Shells were themselves surrounded by an additional estimated two thousand decks.
